Ready to start a new job?

Looking for an active warehouse job?

Start your next job at GXO Logistics in Tilburg!

Work in a modern warehouse with an international team. You will pick, pack, and ship customer orders correctly and on time.

No warehouse experience? That's okay! If you are motivated, willing to learn, and like to stay active, we will train you and help you grow.

Please note: This is an active, physical job. You'll be walking, standing and moving throughout your shift.

What will you do?

As a Warehouse Employee, you can work in different departments.

Order Picking

- Pick products using a hand scanner.
- Collect the correct items for customer orders.
- Make sure orders are complete.

Packing

- Scan products.
- Check orders before shipment.
- Print shipping labels.

Returns

- Inspect returned products.
- Decide whether products can be returned to stock.
- Process returns in the warehouse system.

Together with your colleagues, you'll ensure every product is handled carefully from the moment it arrives until it leaves the warehouse.

What do we ask?

- You speak and understand basic English (minimum B1).
- You are available full-time or part-time.
- You enjoy active work and are physically fit.
- You can stand and walk throughout your shift.
- You have your own accommodation and transportation.
- You can apply for a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG).

Working hours in aTwo-shift system

Morning: 06:00 - 14:45

Afternoon: 15:15 - 00:00

Are you looking for a fun and dynamic job where you can truly make a difference in logistics?As an Order Picker and Packer at GXO Logistics in Tilburg, you play an essential role in keeping the warehouse running smoothly together with your team. No two days are the same, and your tasks will vary depending on the department you work in.

Online departments

- Picking: You collect products using a scanner and ensure each order contains the correct items before sending them to packing.
- Packing: At a packing station, you scan items, check that orders are complete, and prepare packages for shipment, including printing labels.
- Returns: You inspect returned items for quality and process them correctly, ensuring they are restocked or sent back to the supplier when needed.

You’ll be part of a friendly, international team where communication and teamwork are key. Together, you make sure every order is processed quickly and accurately, so customers receive their orders with a smile.

Retail department

- PBR (Retail operations): In this department, you handle products intended for in-store use. You can be trained in multiple processes, including Picking, Receiving, Put-Away, Allocation, Inbound, and Outbound.

Here, you’ll work in a close-knit team, ensuring that all products are handled with care and efficiency from the moment they arrive at the warehouse until they are shipped to stores.

Hard requirements

- You can communicate in English (minimum B1 level).
- You are physically fit and able to stand and walk for extended periods.
- You are available to work either a fixed morning shift or in a two-shift rotation.
- You have your own accommodation and transportation.
- You are able to apply for a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG).
- You are available full-time and can work from Monday to Saturday in 2 shifts.

Working hours:

Morning shift 06:00 – 14:45 and Afternoon shift 15:15 – 00:00
